sourceColorSpace: canonical sRGB code values; convert to linear sRGB only for matching/compositing

context.region: mask-free Chebyshev distance 5 through 32 pixels from any nonzero original final mask pixel
context.fitValidationSplit: parity of 16x16 image blocks; even fit, odd validation

estimator.kind: independent channel multiplicative gains in linear RGB
estimator.formula: gain[c] = exp(median(log(sourceLinear[c]) - log(nativeLinear[c]))) on fit context only

application.target: new explicit candidate pipeline output only
application.formula: correctedNativeLinear = nativeLinear * gain; mix with sourceLinear by the unchanged original final mask
application.sourceAlpha: copy every original alpha byte exactly
application.failure: reject candidate result; retain raw output and diagnostics, no silent success or gain clamping

releaseCriteria: All existing visual quality, geometry, alpha, exterior preservation, runtime, memory, cancel and preview gates remain unchanged; context-color validation alone is not a quality PASS. Requires new explicit evaluation after review.
knownLimits: A single global gain cannot repair changed line geometry or spatially varying VAE/diffusion artifacts.
Context may be unsuitable or insufficient for a source; reject rather than infer from generated replacement pixels.
Intentional generated colors also receive the global correction; all six frozen fixture gates must assess this.
